description: Create a durable order that spends `amount` of fromToken. Returns the deposit address and exact amount to send. Confirm with the user first. Never retry after a timeout or error: another call creates another order.

amount.description: Human decimal amount, e.g. "0.5". Not atomic units.

fromToken.description: Token address from search_tokens, or "native" for the chain coin.

refundAddress.description: Only for a native-coin source such as XMR or TRX; token sources refund to the sender.

toToken.description: Token address from search_tokens, or "native" for the chain coin.

name: create_swap
title: Create a swap order
